name: Cologne vocational student finding an electrical apprenticeship

context.company_awareness: Recognizes transit/utility brands but not smaller training firms.

trigger: A school adviser asks for a training-employer shortlist and the student discovers that 2027 applications are already advertised.

searches_run.observation: Retrieved BA apprenticeship searches and direct KVB, Siemens, SPIE and Deutsche Bahn listings. The inspected BA KVB listing provides training type, school qualification, start date and local address.

Results included precise 2027 starts but did not establish a universal application deadline. Siemens snippets place vocational-school teaching in Düsseldorf despite a Cologne title, raising a second commute dimension.

sources.supports: Direct inspection lists apprenticeship, Cologne address, required school qualification and 30 August 2027 start; deadline not established.

best_entry_page.promise: A local guide to covered training employers, electrical specializations and source-linked 2027 openings, with start dates kept separate from application deadlines.
best_entry_page.cta: Explore covered local employers and save apprenticeship searches; check each original application page.
proof_needed: Actual Cologne apprenticeship coverage including smaller employers
Source-backed deadlines if stated, unknown otherwise

conversion_objections: Does this include apprenticeships or mostly jobs for qualified people?
I do not know the correct specialization name.
Large brands are visible already on BA; are local firms included?
A new-job email will not remind me before a closing date.

avoid_targeting.reason: Exam preparation is unrelated to discovery functionality.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
